practical: Review of FDS block diagram and component interconnections
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the Flight Director System?
Why is an AFCS necessary in modern aircraft?
Can you list three basic components of a Flight Director?

topics: Role of AFCS in flight control
development.content:
Definition and purpose of FDS
Need for automated flight guidance
Basic FDS block diagram overview
Role of AFCS in flight control
Integration with autopilot systems

Pitch command generation logic
Roll command generation logic
Sensor inputs for FDS
Error signal processing
Display symbology interpretation

FDS failure modes and indications
Pilot override procedures
Maintenance access points
Troubleshooting common faults
Safety implications of FDS failure

summary_questions: Explain how the AFCS uses sensor data to generate flight commands.
Describe the pilot's role when the FDS indicates a system fault.
Differentiate between the functions of the FDS and the autopilot.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the transition from manual to automatic flight using FDS guidance, referencing LP 02.
